title: Little gourd (Kundru): modeled ₹496/qtl left, Perumbavoor → Pampady
summary: January 2025: reported little gourd (Kundru) prices at Perumbavoor and Pampady imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 82% of 22 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹496 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 222 same-variety market pairs screened for little gourd (Kundru) in January 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Pampady report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor (Kerala) and Pampady (Kerala) both reported little gourd (Kundru) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 22 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor reported a median ₹3,750 per quintal. Pampady reported a median ₹4,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,000 per quintal, and Pampady was dearer on 86% of days.

scenes.headline: 76 km by road
scenes.caption: 76 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹16/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹565 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹334 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Pampady report, the rule selects 15 of 22 modeled shipping days. 14 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹496 per quintal (₹265 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Little gourd (Kundru) route from Perumbavoor to Pampady was positive on 82% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹49,600, or ₹26,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to little gourd (Kundru)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹16/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Little gourd (Kundru) route from Perumbavoor to Pampady was positive on 82% of matched days in January 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹49,600, or ₹26,500 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
